newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pioneer Hi-Bred targets reviewed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pioneer Hi-Bred targets reviewed.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securites Inc said on Monday its price objectives are under review for seed company Pioneer Hi-Bred International Inc of $70 a share for the short-term and $82 longer term.
-- Pioneer shares were up 3/4 at 68-1/4 at mid-day Monday.
-- EVEREN said Pioneer has raised its corn seed prices by an average of seven percent to $80.30 per bag, and its soybean seed prices by an average of six percent.

-- The seven percent rise in corn prices includes a shift in product mix to more expensive hybrids, but does not include any genetically enhanced Bt seed since Pioneer has not yet received U.S. regulatory approval.

-- "Assuming the company gets clearance (which other seed companies already have), the price increase should average eight percent, based on the approximately $25 per bag premium that Pioneer will charge for its Bt," EVEREN said.
-- EVEREN said its earnings estimates remain $3.10 a share for fiscal 1997 and $3.60 for fiscal 1998.
